+import base64
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+GOOGLE_KMS_BASE_URL = "https://cloudkms.googleapis.com/v1"
+
+
+def _access_token() -> str:
+    token = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN") or os.environ.get("GCP_ACCESS_TOKEN")
+    if token:
+        return token
+    try:
+        import google.auth
+        from google.auth.transport.requests import Request
+
+        credentials, _ = google.auth.default(scopes=["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform"])
+        if not credentials.valid:
+            credentials.refresh(Request())
+        if not credentials.token:
+            raise RuntimeError("Unable to obtain Google Cloud access token")
+        return credentials.token
+    except Exception as exc:
+        raise RuntimeError("Missing Google Cloud authentication") from exc
+
+
+def _headers() -> Dict[str, str]:
+    return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {_access_token()}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
+
+
+def sign_key(resource_name: str, payload: bytes) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    url = f"{GOOGLE_KMS_BASE_URL}/{resource_name}:asymmetricSign"
+    body = {"digest": {"sha256": base64.b64encode(payload).decode("ascii")}}
+    response = requests.post(url, headers=_headers(), data=json.dumps(body), timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
+
+
+def verify_key(resource_name: str, message: bytes, signature: bytes) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    url = f"{GOOGLE_KMS_BASE_URL}/{resource_name}:asymmetricVerify"
+    body = {
+        "digest": {"sha256": base64.b64encode(message).decode("ascii")},
+        "signature": base64.b64encode(signature).decode("ascii"),
+    }
+    response = requests.post(url, headers=_headers(), data=json.dumps(body), timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
+
+
+def _main(argv: Optional[list] = None) -> int:
+    args = list(sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv)
+    if len(args) < 3:
+        print("usage: sign_or_verify_key.py <sign|verify> <resource_name> <payload> [signature_b64]", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    action, resource_name, payload = args[0], args[1], args[2].encode("utf-8")
+    if action == "sign":
+        result = sign_key(resource_name, payload)
+    elif action == "verify":
+        if len(args) < 4:
+            print("verify requires signature_b64", file=sys.stderr)
+            return 2
+        result = verify_key(resource_name, payload, base64.b64decode(args[3]))
+    else:
+        print("action must be sign or verify", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(_main())
*** End Patch

+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+import boto3
+from botocore.exceptions import BotoCoreError, ClientError
+from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers.aead import AESGCM
+
+
+AWS_KMS_KEY_ID_ENV = "AWS_KMS_KEY_ID"
+AWS_REGION_ENV = "AWS_REGION"
+
+
+def _kms_client() -> Any:
+    region = os.getenv(AWS_REGION_ENV)
+    if region:
+        return boto3.client("kms", region_name=region)
+    return boto3.client("kms")
+
+
+def envelope_encrypt(plaintext: bytes) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    if not isinstance(plaintext, (bytes, bytearray)):
+        raise TypeError("plaintext must be bytes")
+
+    key_id = os.getenv(AWS_KMS_KEY_ID_ENV)
+    if not key_id:
+        raise ValueError("AWS_KMS_KEY_ID is required")
+
+    kms = _kms_client()
+    try:
+        response = kms.generate_data_key(KeyId=key_id, KeySpec="AES_256")
+    except (BotoCoreError, ClientError) as exc:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"AWS KMS generate_data_key failed: {exc}") from exc
+
+    data_key_plaintext = response["Plaintext"]
+    data_key_ciphertext = response["CiphertextBlob"]
+
+    aesgcm = AESGCM(data_key_plaintext)
+    nonce = os.urandom(12)
+    ciphertext = aesgcm.encrypt(nonce, bytes(plaintext), None)
+
+    return {
+        "provider": "aws-kms",
+        "key_id": key_id,
+        "encrypted_data_key": base64.b64encode(data_key_ciphertext).decode("utf-8"),
+        "nonce": base64.b64encode(nonce).decode("utf-8"),
+        "ciphertext": base64.b64encode(ciphertext).decode("utf-8"),
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import sys
+
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
+        raise SystemExit("usage: envelope_encrypt.py <plaintext>")
+    payload = envelope_encrypt(sys.argv[1].encode("utf-8"))
+    print(json.dumps(payload))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import argparse
+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any
+
+import requests
+
+
+def decrypt_payload(ciphertext_b64: str, key_uri: str, project_id: str, location: str, key_ring: str, key_name: str, key_version: str = "1") -> bytes:
+    token = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN")
+    if not token:
+        raise RuntimeError("GOOGLE_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN is required")
+
+    url = f"https://cloudkms.googleapis.com/v1/projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/keyRings/{key_ring}/cryptoKeys/{key_name}/cryptoKeyVersions/{key_version}:decrypt"
+    payload = {
+        "ciphertext": ciphertext_b64,
+    }
+    if key_uri:
+        payload["additionalAuthenticatedData"] = base64.b64encode(key_uri.encode("utf-8")).decode("ascii")
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        url,
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        data=json.dumps(payload),
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data: Any = response.json()
+    return base64.b64decode(data["plaintext"])
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("ciphertext_b64")
+    parser.add_argument("project_id")
+    parser.add_argument("location")
+    parser.add_argument("key_ring")
+    parser.add_argument("key_name")
+    parser.add_argument("--key-version", default="1")
+    parser.add_argument("--key-uri", default="")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    plaintext = decrypt_payload(
+        args.ciphertext_b64,
+        args.key_uri,
+        args.project_id,
+        args.location,
+        args.key_ring,
+        args.key_name,
+        args.key_version,
+    )
+    os.write(1, plaintext)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
